sources.entry: UMST - Desktop calendar widget that shows Google, iCloud and Outlook calendars, Apple Reminders, Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle and other LMS deadlines, and Todoist, Asana and Trello tasks, with menu bar quick add.

summary.one_liner: UMST is a free, open-source desktop calendar widget for macOS that combines your calendars, Apple Reminders, school LMS deadlines and task apps in one view, with menu bar quick-add.
summary.what_it_does: UMST places a glass calendar widget on the macOS desktop, beneath your windows, showing the next two weeks. It aggregates events from every calendar on the Mac (Google, iCloud, Outlook exchange and similar via macOS Internet Accounts), Apple Reminders with due dates, and feeds from Canvas, Blackboard, Brightspace, Moodle, Schoology, Todoist, Asana and Trello, plus any iCal/.ics/webcal link. To-dos and reminders can be checked off directly on the calendar. A menu bar icon opens a quick-add box where items default to today and can be moved to tomorrow or another date. The widget offers six themes and can refresh on login, hourly, at midnight, on wake, and when Calendar or Reminders changes. The installer also sets up Show Desktop, a separate app by another author that hides all windows.
use_cases: see school LMS deadlines in one place
view Google, iCloud and Outlook calendars on the Mac desktop
quickly add to-dos from the menu bar
track Todoist, Asana or Trello tasks alongside events
keep a student schedule visible on the desktop
check off Apple Reminders from a calendar widget
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | zsh   (installs UMST.app to ~/Applications and also installs Show Desktop; the URL is missing from the README text)
curl -fsSL | SHOW_DESKTOP=0 zsh   (install without Show Desktop)
git clone the repository, then cd UMST-UltimateMacSchedulingTool
./scripts/install-from-source.sh   (build, install and launch; requires Xcode Command Line Tools)
notable: Free and open source under MIT, with no accounts, analytics or servers; feed links and tokens stored in the macOS Keychain
Aggregates LMS feeds (Canvas, Blackboard, Brightspace, Moodle, Schoology) alongside calendars and task apps, which the README's comparison table says competitors lack
Menu bar quick add: type and press Return, items default to today and clear at midnight
Bundles or installs Show Desktop to hide all windows and reveal the desktop widget
No third-party dependencies; builds as a universal binary
caveats: Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later; Apple silicon or Intel
Not notarized by Apple, so the first launch needs approval under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway
Provided 'as is' without warranty; README advises double-checking important deadlines in the original source
Some sources need manual setup, such as copying iCal links or Canvas access tokens
Offline mode shows only the last downloaded data
